visual_standard.rule: Lead with project imagery, not generic text cards. Each campaign stays tied to one source project and one marketing idea.

carousels.campaign_goal: Sell the value of an interactive brand experience through spatial imagery.
carousels.caption:
A place should be experienced before it is visited.

Growth Terminal builds interactive brand experiences that let people understand the atmosphere, movement and point of view before they ever arrive.

Atelier Veyra is a Growth Terminal studio concept, not a client commission.

carousels.campaign_goal: Show how product storytelling can reveal construction and make value easier to understand.
carousels.caption:
Do not stop at the finished product. Show how the value is built.

Meridian Pavilion moves from the complete object to the system underneath it, turning construction into a product story people can actually understand.

Meridian Pavilion is a Growth Terminal image study, not a working configurator.

carousels.caption:
Different briefs should not collapse into the same visual answer.

carousels.campaign_goal: Explain that photography, technical imagery and 3D are selected by communication need.
carousels.caption:
The medium should follow the material.

A spatial experience may need photography or film. A product story may need a technical breakdown. A brand system may need a 3D object that becomes part of the interface. Growth Terminal chooses the medium around the job it has to do.
